oneOf.description: Source company (or business unit/assets) was acquired by target company.
Source and target companies merged into a combined organization.
Source company supplies OEM subsystems (robotic arms, haptic masters, optics) integrated into target company's systems.
Strategic partnership, joint venture, co-development, IP licensing, investment, or distribution agreement.

id.description: Unique relationship identifier (typically <source>_<target>, matching the filename).

source.description: Source company ID (snake_case slug in public/companies/, or predecessor/external entity ID).

source_name.description: Display name for the source entity when it does not have a standalone entry in public/companies/.

source_founded_year.description: Founding year of an external or predecessor source entity not listed in public/companies/.

target.description: Target company ID (snake_case slug in public/companies/, or external partner entity ID).

target_name.description: Display name for the target entity when it does not have a standalone entry in public/companies/.

subtype.description: Short descriptive label for the relationship (e.g. 'Acquisition ($1.65B)', 'sigma.7 Haptic Master OEM', 'Global Distribution').

year.description: Year when the acquisition, merger, OEM supply, or collaboration took effect.

note.description: Concise factual summary of the relationship.

sources.description: Non-empty array of authoritative source URLs documenting the relationship.
